posts.author: MarioLuigi34
posts.body:
This is my third free Generator Pack for RPG Maker MZ.
This pack is free, I just want you to credit me when using the parts!
It includes:
- beaks (With 7 facial expressions and 3 overworld variants.)
- Dotted Eyebrows.
- Mad Dotted Eyebrows.
- Side Eyes.
- Button Eyes.
- TV Head (No face sprite.)
- Black Eyes with a no-face sprite variant.
- The "3" mouth.
(Stiched Mouths.)
- Stitched Smile.
-Stitched Frown.
- Stitched Nose.
- Round Nose.
- And a Masculine Nose for Females.
Here is the link, I hope this can help people with their RPG Maker MZ projects:
